New valid Gemma 4 26B A4B Q8 single-B70 record from 2026-06-23 fast top-k MTP draft sampler bypass patch on llama.cpp c926ad098. Uses UD-Q8_K_XL main GGUF plus official Gemma MTP draft, --spec-draft-n-max 7 --spec-draft-n-min 2 --spec-draft-p-min 0.12 --no-spec-draft-backend-sampling --spec-draft-threads 32 --spec-draft-threads-batch 32, --ctx-checkpoints 0, and LLAMA_MTP_DRAFT_FAST_TOPK=1 with LLAMA_MTP_DRAFT_TOP_K=10 to bypass generic sampler overhead in the MTP draft loop while preserving the existing top-k-normalized p-min gate. Main and draft KV are f16/f16, flash-attn off, poll 50, filled-long 588 prompt / 512 output benchmark. Validated by repo 384-row chat canary before measurement. Repeat confirmed the tiny first-sweep win: best promoted run reached 91.6189 tok/s after TTFT, superseding cmqqkmbhr017oqo017rdfxqh2 at 91.1567 tok/s. tokSTotal is warmed repeated-prompt wall throughput; tokSOut after TTFT is the promoted comparison metric. Supporting repo paths: results/gemma4-26b-a4b-q8-b70/, experiments/gemma4-26b-a4b-q8-b70/sweeps/20260623T1504-fast-topk.md, and patches/gemma4-llamacpp-mtp-draft-fast-topk-20260623.patch.
